TRANSFORMER ENCODER · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Understanding words through their surrounding context

A Transformer Encoder turns input tokens into context-aware hidden representations using attention, feed-forward transformations, residual connections, and normalization.

questions.stem: Transformer Encoder అంటే ఏమిటి? Sentenceలో Tokens మధ్య Relationships, Meaningని Context-Aware Representationsగా ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
options: Encoder Every Layerలో Future Tokensని Mask చేసి Only Next Token Predict చేస్తుంది.
Encoder Surrounding Wordsతో Contextual Meaning, Relations Learn చేస్తుంది.
Encoder Each Wordని Separate Translate చేసి Distant Contextని Never Use చేస్తుంది.
Encoder Whole Sentences Memorize చేసి Matching Textని మాత్రమే Retrieve చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Encoder Wordsని Together Read చేస్తుంది. Surrounding Words వల్ల Each Token Meaning Betterగా Represent అవుతుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Encoder Blocks Generally Non-Causal Self-Attention Use చేసి Input Tokensకి Contextual Hidden States Build చేస్తాయి. Output Fixed Labels కాదు; Task Head Classification, NER etcకి Add అవుతుంది.

questions.stem: Encoder Layerలో Multi-Head Self-Attention, Feed-Forward Network, Residual Connection, Layer Normalization ఒక్కొక్కటి ఏ Role Play చేస్తాయి?
options: Self-Attention Context Remove; Feed-Forward Only Tokenizes; Residuals Previous Signals Erase చేస్తాయి.
LayerNorm Dictionary Meaning Select చేసి Attention Direct Final Vocabulary Probabilities ఇస్తుంది.
Feed-Forward Attentionని Replace చేస్తుంది; Residual Connections Tokens Share కాకుండా Block చేస్తాయి.
Attention Mix; FFN Transform; Residuals Preserve; LayerNorm Stabilize చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Attention Words మధ్య Information Exchange చేస్తుంది. Feed-Forward Features Transform; Residuals Earlier Signal Keep; LayerNorm Stabilize చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Multi-Head Self-Attention Token Positions Across Mix చేస్తుంది; Positionwise FFN ప్రతి Token Features Transform చేస్తుంది. Residual Shortcuts Gradient Path, LayerNorm Activation Stability Support చేస్తాయి.

questions.stem: “The bank is near the river” Sentenceలో “bank” అంటే Financial Institution కాదు River Edge అని Encoder Context ద్వారా ఎలా Understand చేస్తుంది?
options: Encoder “river” Contextతో “bank”కి River Edge Meaning Represent చేయవచ్చు.
“bank”కి Always Financial Meaning Fixedగా ఉంటుంది; Contextతో Change కాదు.
Encoder “river” Ignore చేసి Only Global Word Frequency Basedగా Decide చేస్తుంది.
Meaning Distinguish చేయడానికి Sentenceని Other Languageకి First Translate చేయాలి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: “river” Word ఉండటం వల్ల “bank”కి River Side Meaning More Likely అవుతుంది. Context Ambiguityని Reduce చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. “bank” Hidden State “river” నుంచి Attention-based Context Receive చేయవచ్చు. Learned Model Data, Contextపై Disambiguation Depend; Perfect Meaning Guaranteed కాదు.

questions.stem: Token Embeddings, Position Information, Q/K/V Projections, Attention, Feed-Forward Operations గుండా Encoderలో Information Flow ఎలా జరుగుతుంది?
options: Tokensకి Embeddings Create చేయకముందే Labels Classify చేసి Position IDs Generate చేస్తాం.
Position Encoding Token Embeddingsని Replace చేస్తుంది; Q/K Token Features లేకుండా Compute అవుతాయి.
Token Embeddings, Positions Combine; Q/K/V Attention; Feed-Forward Context Refine చేస్తుంది.
Values Output Classify చేసిన తర్వాత Queries Create; Residuals Attention Completely Skip చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First Tokens, Positionsకి Vectors వస్తాయి. Then Q/K/V Attention Context Mix చేసి Feed-Forward మరింత Transform చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Tokenize→Embeddings+Position→Q/K/V Linear Projections→Scaled Dot-Product Attention→Multi-Head Merge→Residual/Norm→FFN→Residual/Norm. Pre-LN, Post-LN Order Architecturesలో Differ అవుతుంది.

04 · Medium · information flow

Follow the complete encoder data flow

Simple takeaway: Projection makes Q, K, and V; attention combines Value information before further residual and feed-forward processing.

questions.stem: Softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V Formula, Multiple Heads, Residuals, Normalization, Stacked Layers ఉపయోగించి Encoder Contextual Features ఎలా Compute చేస్తుంది?
options: Valuesపై First Softmax Apply చేసి Q/K Matricesని Final Class Labelతో Add చేస్తాం.
Scaled Q/K Scoresకి Softmax Weights; Values Mix; Layers, Residuals Context Refine చేస్తాయి.
All Tokensకి Fixed Attention Scores; Normalization Hidden Statesని Never Update చేయనివ్వదు.
Residual Layer Every Head Output Erase చేస్తుంది; Deeper Layers Context Accumulate చేయవు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Q/K Similarity Scores Softmax Weights అవుతాయి. Values Combine చేసి Multiple Layers Richer Representations Build చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. head=softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V. Attention Weights Rowwise Normalize అవుతాయి. Heads Concatenate, W_O Project; Residual + FFN, Stacking ద్వారా Contextual Features Iteratively Change అవుతాయి.
questions.figure:
05 · Medium · mathematical attention

Softmax weights Values to form contextual vectors

Simple takeaway: Similarity scores become attention weights; each Query's weights add up to one and mix information from Values.

Formula: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V. Multiple heads project Q/K/V separately; residual and normalized feed-forward steps refine their combined output. Shown weights are illustrative.

options: Encoders Future Tokens Hide చేస్తాయి; Bidirectional Context Trainingలో Possible కాదు.
Decoder-Only Future Tokens Read; Encoders One Token At Time Read చేస్తాయి.

Encoder Both Directions Context Use; Causal Decoder Future Positions Mask చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Encoderకి Earlier, Later Words Both Visible. Decoder Future Tokens Hide చేస్తుంది; అందుకే Encoder Understanding Tasksకి Useful.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Encoder Self-Attention Normally Bidirectional, Causal Decoder Positions j>i Mask చేస్తుంది. BERT Masked-Token Pretraining, Classification/NER Heads, Semantic Representationsకు Suitable.
questions.figure:
06 · Advanced · encoder versus decoder

Encoders can see both sides; causal decoders hide future positions

Simple takeaway: BERT-style encoders are useful for understanding complete input text, while decoder-only models mask future tokens for generation.

questions.stem: Long Input Encoderలో Quadratic Attention, Memory, Position Challengesని Sparse Attention, FlashAttention, Gradient Checkpointing, Efficient Designs ఎలా Handle చేస్తాయి?
options: Long Attention Cost; Sparse, FlashAttention, Checkpointing Different Bottlenecks Target చేస్తాయి.
FlashAttention Entire Attention Compute Eliminate చేసి Unlimited Context Freeగా Support చేస్తుంది.
Checkpointing Activations Recompute చేయకుండా Positional Information Accuracy Automatically Raise చేస్తుంది.
Sparse Attention Every Pairwise Interaction Preserve చేస్తుంది; Normalization Quadratic Cost Remove చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Long Sequencesలో Attention Memory, Compute Increase అవుతాయి. Sparse Links, Efficient Kernels, Checkpointing Different Costs Target చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Dense Attention Pairwise O(N²) Scores Computes. Sparse Methods Connectivity Reduce; FlashAttention Exact Dense Attention IO Efficiently; Checkpointing Backpropకి Activations Recompute చేసి Memory Save చేస్తుంది.
questions.figure:
07 · Advanced · scaling challenges

Long input can strain GPU memory and computation

Simple takeaway: Sparse patterns reduce interactions; FlashAttention reduces memory traffic; checkpointing recomputes activations to save memory.

Technical distinction: Dense attention has O(N²) score interactions. Sparse methods reduce connections; FlashAttention tiles exact attention and avoids saving a full attention matrix; activation checkpointing trades extra recomputation for lower memory. Positional extrapolation and training stability need separate evaluation.
